name: Homedex
description: Read-only inventory of the services, hosts, ports, routes, certificates, domains and changes in your homelab.
longDescription:
The missing inventory for your homelab. Homedex builds a searchable record of what runs where from what your infrastructure reports, instead of another spreadsheet to maintain.

  • Docker: containers, images, Compose stacks, ports and networks, read through the bundled socket proxy that rejects every write.
  • Proxmox VE and Tailscale: nodes, VMs, containers and tailnet devices, each shown on the machine it runs on.
  • Reverse proxies: Traefik, Caddy, Nginx Proxy Manager and nginx routes followed from domain to container, with broken chains flagged.
  • Expiry and changes: certificates and domains by days remaining, containers with a newer image, and what moved between scans.

Homedex only reads. It never starts, stops or reconfigures anything and sends no telemetry.

Host access: only the socket proxy receives the Docker socket, read only, with POST=0 so the Docker API rejects every write; Homedex itself runs as an unprivileged user with every capability dropped.
